questions.passage: First of all, we apologize for contacting you during the holiday season. ① We understand that this is a busy time, but as the revision deadline of your manuscript (December 27th) is quickly approaching, we kindly ask for your cooperation in addressing the reviewers' comments as thoroughly as possible within the limited time available. ② The reviewers have carefully evaluated your manuscript and provided insightful and critical feedback. ③ Please review these comments carefully and submit a revised version of your manuscript. ④ We are confident that incorporating these suggestions will significantly improve the manuscript and provide stronger support for your main claims.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?
To help you revise, we have summarized the key points raised by both reviewers.

det.korean: 리뷰어가 피드백을 제공했다는 내용(②) 직후에, 수정을 돕기 위해 핵심 사항을 요약했다는 문장이 오고, 그 다음에 수정본 제출 요청(③)이 이어지는 것이 자연스럽다.
det.analysis:
✅③: insightful and critical feedback 서술 직후 → "To help you revise"의 논리적 연결
❌①: 아직 상황 설명 전
❌②: 리뷰어 평가 언급 전
❌④: 이미 수정본 제출 요청 후
det.tip: "To help you revise"의 you revise는 피드백 제공 이후의 행위 → 피드백 직후 위치

questions.passage: We are confident that __________ and provide stronger support for your main claims. We hope that the revised manuscript will satisfy the reviewers and be accepted in our journal.
questions.stem:
주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오.
will / these / improve / incorporating / significantly / suggestions / the manuscript

det.korean: 동명사 주어(incorporating these suggestions) + will significantly improve + the manuscript
det.analysis: incorporating these suggestions(동명사구 주어) + will(조동사) + significantly(부사) + improve(동사) + the manuscript(목적어)
det.tip: 동명사구 주어 + 조동사 will + 부사 significantly + 동사 improve + 목적어

questions.wa: incorporating these suggestions will significantly improve the manuscript
accept: incorporating these suggestions will significantly improve the manuscript

questions.passage: First of all, we apologize for contacting you during the holiday season. We understand that this is a busy time, but as the revision deadline of your manuscript (December 27th) is quickly approaching, we kindly ask for your cooperation in __________ within the limited time available.
questions.stem:
주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오.
as / the / comments / addressing / thoroughly / as / reviewers' / possible

det.korean: 리뷰어의 의견을 가능한 한 철저하게 다루는(addressing the reviewers' comments as thoroughly as possible)
det.analysis: addressing(동명사) + the reviewers' comments(목적어) + as thoroughly as possible(부사구)
det.tip: as ~ as possible = 가능한 한 ~하게 / cooperation in + 동명사

questions.wa: addressing the reviewers' comments as thoroughly as possible
accept: addressing the reviewers' comments as thoroughly as possible

questions.passage: First of all, we apologize for contacting you during the holiday season. We understand that this ①<u>is</u> a busy time, but as the revision deadline of your manuscript (December 27th) is quickly approaching, we kindly ask for your cooperation in ②<u>addressing</u> the reviewers' comments as thoroughly as possible within the limited time available. The reviewers have carefully ③<u>evaluating</u> your manuscript and provided insightful and critical feedback. To help you revise, we have summarized the key points ④<u>raised</u> by both reviewers.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ evaluating → evaluated: have + 과거분사 = 현재완료. have evaluating은 문법 오류.
det.analysis:
❌ ③ evaluating: have + 과거분사(evaluated) → have evaluated(현재완료)
✅ ① is: 주어 this에 맞는 동사
✅ ② addressing: cooperation in + 동명사
✅ ④ raised: points raised by(~에 의해 제기된) — 과거분사 수동
det.tip: have + p.p. = 현재완료 (have evaluated, NOT have evaluating)

questions.passage: Please review these comments carefully and submit a revised version of your manuscript. We are confident that incorporating these suggestions will significantly improve the manuscript and provide ①<u>stronger</u> support for your main claims. We hope that the revised manuscript will ②<u>satisfy</u> the reviewers and ③<u>be accepted</u> in our journal. Thank you for your ④<u>attentive</u> and cooperation.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ attentive(형용사) → attention(명사): and로 연결된 병렬 구조에서 cooperation(명사)과 같은 품사여야 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ attentive(주의 깊은, 형용사): your + 명사 + and + 명사 → attention(명사)이 적절
✅ ① stronger(더 강한): 비교급 형용사로 적절
✅ ② satisfy(만족시키다): will + 동사원형
✅ ③ be accepted(수락되다): will + 수동태
det.tip: 병렬 구조: your attention and cooperation — 둘 다 명사여야 함

questions.passage: The reviewers have carefully evaluated your manuscript and provided insightful and critical feedback. To help you revise, we have summarized the key points raised by both reviewers. Please review these comments carefully and submit a __________ version of your manuscript.
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: version은 수정된 대상(수동)이므로 과거분사 revised가 적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ② revised: 과거분사(수동) — version이 수정된 것
❌ ① revise: 동사 원형
❌ ③ revising: 현재분사(능동) — version이 수정하는 것은 어색
❌ ④ to revise: 부정사
det.tip: a revised version = 수정된 판 — 과거분사가 명사를 수식(수동 관계)

questions.passage: First of all, we ①<u>apologize</u> for contacting you during the holiday season. We understand that this is a busy time, but as the revision deadline of your manuscript (December 27th) is quickly ②<u>approaching</u>, we kindly ask for your cooperation in addressing the reviewers' comments as thoroughly as possible within the limited time available. The reviewers have carefully evaluated your manuscript and provided ③<u>shallow</u> and critical feedback. We are confident that incorporating these suggestions will significantly ④<u>improve</u> the manuscript.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 리뷰어들이 신중하게 평가하여 통찰력 있는(insightful) 피드백을 제공했다. shallow(피상적인)는 insightful의 반의어.
det.analysis:
❌ ③ shallow(얕은, 피상적인): 원문은 insightful(통찰력 있는). carefully evaluated와 논리적으로 맞지 않음
✅ ① apologize(사과하다): 적절
✅ ② approaching(다가오는): 적절
✅ ④ improve(개선하다): 적절
det.tip: insightful(통찰력 있는) ↔ shallow(피상적인, 얕은)

questions.passage: We are confident that incorporating these suggestions will significantly improve the manuscript and provide ①<u>stronger</u> support for your main claims. We hope that the revised manuscript will ②<u>satisfy</u> the reviewers and be ③<u>rejected</u> in our journal. Thank you for your ④<u>attention</u> and cooperation.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 수정된 원고가 저널에 수락(accepted)되기를 바란다. rejected(거절된)는 accepted의 반의어.
det.analysis:
❌ ③ rejected(거절된): 원문은 accepted(수락된). 원고가 수락되기를 바라는 맥락과 반대
✅ ① stronger(더 강한): 적절
✅ ② satisfy(만족시키다): 적절
✅ ④ attention(관심, 주의): 적절
det.tip: accepted(수락된) ↔ rejected(거절된)

questions.passage: First of all, we apologize for contacting you during the holiday season. questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 마감이 다가오고 바쁜 시기이므로, 제한된(limited) 시간 내에 가능한 한 철저히 반영해 달라는 뜻.
det.analysis:
✅ limited(제한된): 마감 임박 + busy time → 시간이 제한됨
❌ unlimited(무제한의): 마감이 있으므로 모순
❌ extended(연장된): 마감이 다가오므로 모순
❌ abundant(풍부한): 시간이 부족한 상황과 모순
det.tip: limited time = 제한된 시간 — deadline approaching과 논리적으로 연결

questions.passage: The reviewers have carefully evaluated your manuscript and provided insightful and critical feedback. To help you revise, we have summarized the key points raised by both reviewers. Please review these comments carefully and submit a revised version of your manuscript. We are confident that incorporating these suggestions will significantly improve the manuscript and provide stronger __________ for your main claims.
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 제안을 반영하면 주요 주장에 대한 더 강한 뒷받침(support)을 제공할 것이다.
det.analysis:
✅ support(뒷받침, 지지): improve + stronger support = 논리적 흐름
❌ opposition(반대): 주장을 뒷받침하는 것이지 반대하는 것이 아님
❌ criticism(비판): 이미 피드백 단계를 지남
❌ limitation(제한): 주장을 강화하는 맥락과 반대
det.tip: provide support for claims = 주장에 대한 뒷받침을 제공하다 — 학술 논문 핵심 표현

questions.passage: The reviewers have carefully evaluated your manuscript and provided __________ (insight) and critical feedback. To help you revise, we have summarized the key points raised by both reviewers. Please review these comments carefully and submit a revised version of your manuscript.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞게 어형을 변환하여 빈칸에 쓰시오.

det.korean: insight(명사: 통찰) → insightful(형용사: 통찰력 있는): and로 critical(형용사)과 병렬 연결되므로 형용사 필요.
det.analysis:
insight(명사) → insightful(형용사)
_____ and critical feedback — 병렬 구조에서 형용사 필요
det.tip: insight(명) → insightful(형) — -ful 접미사로 형용사화

det.korean: 편집자가 저자에게 리뷰어 의견 반영 및 수정본 제출을 요청하는 편지.
det.analysis:

❌ ① 논문 심사 결과 발표가 아님

det.korean: 편집자는 원고 개선에 대해 confident(확신)한다고 했으므로, 회의적이라는 설명은 부적절.

✅ ① 휴가철 연락에 대해 사과 → 일치
✅ ② 핵심 사항 요약 제공 → 일치
✅ ③ 수정본 제출 요청 → 일치
det.tip: confident(확신하는) ≠ 회의적인 — 필자의 태도를 정확히 파악

det.analysis:

det.analysis:

✅ ① 휴가철 연락에 대해 사과 → 일치
✅ ② 리뷰어가 통찰력 있는 피드백 제공 → 일치
✅ ④ 저널 수락을 희망 → 일치
det.tip: summarized(요약했다) ≠ 직접 수정했다 — 행위의 범위를 정확히 파악

ch: 편집자가 휴가철에 연락한 것에 대해 사과했다.
